content.text: The zone sensor reading jumps from ~23.5°C (seasonal) to a flat ~25.1°C that holds all year — suspicious of both a "stuck near cooling setpoint (25.25)" fault and a real temperature shift, since the cooling setpoint is unchanged. To disambiguate I would need a room-level temperature stream in this zone, a zone electric-power / energy stream (load), zone CO2 / occupancy, and VAV supply-flow/supply-air-temperature. None of those series exist in this store — only the zone setpoints (cool/heating), the zone temperature sensor itself, and the damper position setpoint exist. Damper setpoint moves consistently with the rising reading, but is the controller's reaction, not independent.

input.needed_streams: Zone_F3_Z01 electric power / energy (load), zone CO2 or occupancy (occupancy proxy), room-level Air_Temperature_Sensors inside Zone_F3_Z01 for independent cross-check, and VAV_F3_Z01 supply-air temperature / supply-air flow / damper command to confirm actuator behaviour consistent with a real temperature change.
